note: Training materials written for the demo from the workspace as built. Each course has a short knowledge check; passing it (80% or more) is what counts as understanding. The cyber security course only records completion of TxDOT's approved programme; its content is TxDOT's, not this demo's.

courses.title: Using the Help desk
materials: Report an issue in a few words and choose how urgent it is; urgency sets the answer deadline.
You get a reference such as TKT-0001, the person who has it, and the time you will hear back.
Check the reference at any time to see the status and the full history.
If a fix did not work, reopen the ticket and say what is still wrong.

questions.q: What decides the deadline for the first answer?
options: How urgent you say it is

questions.q: A ticket was marked resolved but the problem is back. What do you do?
options: Reopen the ticket and say what is still wrong

questions.q: Where do you see everything that happened on a ticket?
options: Its history, opened from the reference

courses.title: Monitoring and performance reports
materials: The monitor records availability and response time for each component, and raises an alert when one stops answering.
A performance report is computed from what was recorded in the period you choose.
A period with no recorded data is refused with the reason, never estimated.
Every report is archived once and checked against its fingerprint when opened.

questions.q: You ask for a report on a week with no monitoring data. What happens?
options: It is refused and says what is missing

questions.q: What happens when a component stops answering?
options: An alert is raised and an incident opened

questions.q: Can an archived report be edited?
options: No; a changed copy fails its fingerprint check

courses.title: Giving feedback and new features
materials: Anyone can give feedback; the development team answers every piece.
Feasible ideas become feature changes: proposed, approved, in build, released.
A change is released only when the team records how it meets the feedback.
Ideas that cannot be done are answered with the reason.

questions.q: What must be recorded before a feature is released?
options: How it meets the feedback it came from

questions.q: Your idea cannot be done. What do you get?
What is the order a change moves through?

courses.title: Cyber security training (TxDOT-approved programme)
materials: Vendor employees must complete a TxDOT-approved cyber security training programme (REQ-020).
This record shows completion and the date; the programme content itself is TxDOT's.
Completion is renewed every year; the compliance checks flag anyone whose completion has lapsed.
